citations.title: Refund posting and payout reconciliation
citations.excerpt: All values are integer minor units in a single currency. Compute ledger net as the signed sum of capture, fee and refund postings. Do not silently treat a pending posting as completed, or hide a present mismatch because it may later resolve.
